verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own API, but it is a single inbound-message endpoint for sending messages programmatically. Because Poke is conversational, that message channel reaches some assistant actions. The CLI adds MCP server registration and recipe creation, but most UI surfaces (integration connect/disconnect, Kitchen payouts, account merging, credit purchases) have no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of integrations, recipes, account and billing management; a machine-readable API spec; evidence of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
With --recipe, the CLI creates a connection and returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal.
